answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and evaluates equivocation across the signer set: when k coordinated identities double-sign, pairwise evidence produces a penalty proportional to k(k−1)/2, or O(k²), rather than k separate fines. Detection also compounds asymmetric depreciation of escrowed stake, giving a swarm’s aggregate capital loss an exponential multiplier as it grows; splitting keys cannot hide shared evidence, whether the identities operate on a vine, knoll, or mesa.
